rule: PROJECT_DECISIONS.md: Use authentic, relevant images when they deepen understanding; no section should exist merely because a component is available. LIBRARY_LAUNCH_PLAN.md: useful licensed images when available.
unacquiredCandidates: No uninspected or access-limited candidate is licensed for inclusion by this decision. No access restriction bypassed.

textOnly.biochemist: Protein-experiment prose explains molecular research; an insulin model is optional enrichment.
textOnly.biomedical-clinical-engineer: Design and hospital technology-management examples explain the engineer role without a misleading technician photograph.
textOnly.biomedical-clinical-technician: Equipment inspection, troubleshooting and service records are concrete; a photo cannot resolve the two-pathway title ambiguity.
textOnly.biostatistician: Study planning, missing observations and uncertainty are explained; historical Nightingale imagery is optional context.
textOnly.cancer-registrar: Casefinding and abstracting examples explain registry work without decorative specialist software diagrams.
textOnly.community-health-worker: Transportation barriers, referral follow-through and relationships supply concrete examples; disputed-license or differently scoped overseas clinical images are unnecessary.
textOnly.health-information-technologist: Inconsistent-report example explains systems and data quality better than an old tablet image; exact title alias remains unresolved.
textOnly.licensed-practical-nurse: Nursing-facility example explains observation, reporting, assigned care and supervision without a historical Haiti photograph.
textOnly.medical-records-specialist: Record-quality and missing-report examples explain the work; uninspected historical paper-file imagery is unnecessary.
textOnly.medical-transcriptionist: Uncertain audio and editing examples explain the occupation more clearly than generic headset imagery.
textOnly.microbiologist: Research, clinical testing and public-health workflows are distinguished; an uninspected colorized micrograph is optional.
textOnly.mri-technologist: Magnetic fields, screening, acquisition and the radiologist's interpretive role are clear without a sample scan.
textOnly.occupational-therapist: Everyday participation and task/environment adaptation are explained; a hand-brace photo could overemphasize one specialty.
textOnly.phlebotomist: Identification, labeling, collection and handling explain the career; procedural needle instruction is outside scope.
textOnly.physical-therapist: Movement evaluation, individualized treatment and reassessment distinguish the role; a portrait adds little information.
textOnly.radiologic-technologist: General radiography, image acquisition and interpretation boundaries are explicit; a chest image does not establish credentials.
textOnly.registered-nurse: Assessment, planning, action and evaluation are explained through a care sequence; historical shipboard imagery is unnecessary.
textOnly.surgical-technologist: Sterile field, counts, instruments and first-assistant distinctions are explained; an uninspected historical operation could obscure the role.

illustrated.athletic-trainer: Existing inspected public-domain image; exact wheelchair-basketball/trials context and creator retained.
illustrated.dental-assistant: Existing inspected licensed training image; blood-pressure measurement context and creator retained.
illustrated.emergency-medical-technician: Existing inspected public-domain EMS image; paramedic/corpsman identities stated, not relabeled as EMTs.
illustrated.medical-assistant: Existing inspected public-domain corpsman image; shared vital-sign task and Navy identity stated.
illustrated.sterile-processing-technician: Existing inspected public-domain demonstration image; context does not claim ideal clinical PPE.
illustrated.paramedic: Verified byte-identical reuse of EMS image; actual identities, task context, credit and no-endorsement notice retained.
